conventions.delivery_order: events.jsonl is sorted by receive_time. Records with equal receive_time keep file order. Each accepted record gets the next ingestion_sequence in file order; refused and duplicate records get none.
conventions.event_time: payload.timestamp (integer seconds) times 1000 when present, else receive_time (0002 Late-event window).
conventions.transient_inputs: transient.ip is the connection peer address and transient.user_agent the User-Agent header. Neither is stored (0001 Transient inputs). No proxy is trusted, so forwarding and geo headers would be ignored.
conventions.geo: transient.country is the result of the configured geo database lookup for transient.ip. The fixture fixes it so results do not depend on a MaxMind build.
conventions.device: Browser, OS, and device for each user agent and screen are fixed in user-agents.json so results do not depend on a UA parser version.
conventions.watermark: All records are ingested and corrected before evaluation_instant. Retention uses evaluation_instant as the result watermark.
